description: The card that says what an @name is: a small popover (no arrow, no focus) just under the pointer while it rests on the name, in a page of notes, in Meta's replies, or in a chat being read.
opens: rest the pointer on an @name in notes
rest the pointer on a name linked in a chat read or in Meta's replies

phone.does: A long-press reveals the same controls
phone.why: No hover on touch; a long-press is Android's equivalent of the desktop's right-click

parts.name: card
parts.shows: One line "{name}: {kind} · {summary}" (wraps at 64 characters; hovering the time-bearing part shows when). It waits 0.3 seconds before it comes up; it is not shown while a mouse button is held (text being selected); a press calls it off. It stays 0.35 seconds after the pointer leaves the name, and while the pointer is on the card.

actions.by: click "To notes" (only on names in a chat or in Meta's replies)
actions.does: Writes "- @name: " at the end of the page of notes shown (Home if none), the caret after it to say what it means to you.

states.name: no pointer
states.shows: Where there is nothing on screen to put it under, the same line is a toast at the window's bottom for 6 seconds, with a "To notes" button for names from a chat.
